directory_semantics.inbox/: Append-only raw submissions merged into canonical history.
directory_semantics.agents/: Optional participant continuity namespaces. Participants may revise their own current records; Git history preserves earlier states.
directory_semantics.threads/: Threaded communication records. One event per file is preferred for concurrency and provenance.
directory_semantics.templates/: Optional starting structures; not identity specifications.
